name: Selective UK SaaS account executive

constraints: Real fixed base salary plus commission
context.company_awareness: Has preferred SaaS employers and can name several

trigger: A recruiter promotes an attractive earnings figure that turns out to be entirely variable, making the candidate more careful about compensation wording.

searches_run.query: account executive SaaS jobs UK base salary commission
searches_run.observation: Results mixed recruiter ads, employer ATS pages and salary guides. DualEntry's snippet separated base and commission; an Indeed page also surfaced a commission-only opportunity under broad B2B SaaS search.

searches_run.query: account executive UK jobs guaranteed basic salary not commission only
searches_run.observation: Retrieved pages used base, commission, OTE and earnings inconsistently. Direct PIE inspection found a base-plus-commission role with different lower bounds in its heading and body, supporting the need to inspect source detail.

sources.title: Account Executive — DualEntry
sources.supports: Search snippet distinguishes base salary, commission and OTE. Direct opening returned a JavaScript shell, so current details were not independently inspected.

sources.title: Account Executive SaaS B2B jobs — Indeed
sources.supports: Retrieved snippet includes a self-employed commission-only role. It shows broad retrieval can contain the persona's excluded compensation model.

sources.title: Account Executive - AI SaaS — PIE Recruitment
sources.supports: Directly inspected recruiter page states base plus commission and consultative SaaS duties; heading and body show different base lower bounds. This is evidence of advertised wording, not contractual guarantees or attainable earnings.

best_entry_page.primary_query: SaaS account executive jobs UK base salary commission
best_entry_page.promise: Compare published base salary and variable-pay wording in SaaS openings, then follow selected employers.
best_entry_page.cta: Search account executive roles at your target companies and inspect the compensation breakdown.
proof_needed: Demonstrate whether salary filtering distinguishes base from OTE; do not imply it already does.
Show source compensation text and conflicting or missing figures.
Pro description checks must distinguish no base from base plus commission.
New indexable guide needed; search/company pages remain noindex.

conversion_objections: Is the salary figure base, OTE or estimated earnings?
Can a no-commission filter accidentally remove base-plus-commission roles?
Can you identify door-to-door duties without excluding legitimate client visits?
Why use this instead of employer alerts?

avoid_targeting.reason: Contract/legal advice is outside the demonstrated product.
Description checks do not verify employers.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Commission is welcome; pretending it is my basic salary is not. Show the advertised base separately from the upside, and let me follow the SaaS companies I would actually join.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona. Two searches and one successful direct inspection; no salary benchmark or earnings forecast is derived. Exact base requirement and target companies are unspecified.
